status: Reference read handlers resolved; actual DEG2 negotiation capture remains unestablished
new_scope: Closes the prior unknown about the compiled reference getter and traces D6/D7 reply construction. The log format itself was already identified on 2 November.

flash_getter.behavior: Returns null when the initialized byte is zero, otherwise returns gl_flash_log_ptr. No stores or function calls occur in this function.
flash_getter.observation: Does not start a new capture, clear the record, or request PD messages. The USB wrapper copies the existing 512-byte record to its reply.
flash_getter.limit: Only this compiled reference getter and its inspected wrapper; not the whole firmware and not DEG2.

status_d6.behavior: Replies from gl_dock_status for min(requested length, stored status length); zero reply length returns not handled.
status_d6.fields: Eight-byte header with update status, component count, 16-bit length and 32-bit composite version; 32-byte component entries describe image modes/status and firmware/application versions.
status_d6.limit: Firmware inventory/update state; no identified entry request, reply or trained-link result.

identity_d7.behavior: Copies 72 identity bytes to the EP0 buffer, appends one metadata flag and replies with at most 73 bytes in this reference library.
identity_d7.version_difference: The separately pinned fwupd schema includes a 74th model byte. Do not assume all generations return the same length or treat an absent byte as zero.

compiled_reads.flash_de_dispatch: The compiled application handler returns not handled for DE. The separately compiled optional USB fallback then selects the flash-log getter; matching the public header alone is insufficient.
compiled_reads.reset_d8: Despite the v1 header calling D8 reserved/not implemented, the compiled handler has a branch calling Cy_App_Dmc_ResetState. It was not exercised or sent. This is an update-state reset, not an identified PD Data_Reset.

log_contents.content: Fault counters and compact three-byte event records with one extra data byte; no defined complete PD-message transcript or Enter_USB/Accept/Reject record in the inspected format.
log_contents.filters: Attachment and selected trace events are excluded from flash. The example disables disconnect-event flash logging. UART is a separate build-selected output.
log_contents.latest_public_source: Current master 6e1aa9e5786abef91f288bf70b64d89ea400be81 still has conditional DE/512-byte handling. This source inspection does not match a DEG2 build.
log_contents.expected_use_if_matched: A before/after fault record could expose a reset or electrical fault; an unchanged record could not rule out failed entry.

windows_route.transport: Retained descriptors advertise a WinUSB-compatible vendor interface. Microsoft documents user-mode vendor control transfers through Winusb.dll/Winusb.sys. No new kernel driver is inherently required for that interface, provided it is actually bound and accessible.
windows_route.official_tool: Infineon PMG1-S3 Dock user guide sections 8 and 8.2 documents WinUSB and the Windows EZPD.FwUpdateUtility version/status query. This is component firmware inventory, not a raw CC capture.
windows_route.fwupd_scope: Independent DMC client uses D7 and D6 for inventory and defines a separate firmware-update interrupt protocol. The inspected ccgx-dmc.quirk has no 041F:D002 entry; this file alone is not an exhaustive compatibility database.
windows_route.current_os_metadata: The Windows present-device query returned zero matching 041F:D002 nodes. No handle or device transfer was attempted. This does not establish physical cable or dock-power state.
windows_route.missing: Actual DEG2 controller/build identification and supported commands. An interrupt IN endpoint is not proof it streams PD packets.

dock_sdk.already_acquired: EZ-PD Host SDK 3.9.0; host/AMD reference package
dock_sdk.separate_material: EZ-PD Dock SDK for the Thunderbolt 5 PMG1-S3 design
dock_sdk.vendor_statement: Infineon support directs CYPM1322 Thunderbolt 5 developers to request Dock SDK access; download link follows approval.
dock_sdk.value: Review the TB5 dock USB dispatcher, firmware inventory and debug/log build options, then compare them with DEG2 evidence. More appropriate than assuming the public Goshen Ridge/Griffin Creek example is the TB5 implementation.
dock_sdk.limit: No proof of the fitted DEG2 PD chip, no Minisforum production firmware and no promised raw packet logger. Package not acquired; no login, access request or support message sent.

original_function_checks.limits: Original function bytes with synthetic RAM relocations and stubbed USB buffer/reply, memcpy and compiler switch helper. No actual dock firmware or USB transport executed.

next: Obtain the TB5 Dock SDK or matched Minisforum diagnostic/firmware package and inspect its actual USB handler and logging implementation. Do not run a generic updater or send D6/D7/DE on descriptor resemblance alone. No unchanged dump or cable operation requested while owner is away.
